title: Atori SMP Staffel 2 Pro Edition
description: Modpack for the second season of the Atori SMP. More immersive edition, whilest remaining a vanilla experience.
body:
# Atori SMP Season 2 Modpack (Pro Edition)

This is a modpack for the players of Atori SMP to join the server. This does not include the server-side mods of the SMP.

This edition of the modpack includes more visual changes in comparison to the Mini Edition, however the vanilla experience stays in tact.

There are also two other version of this modpack, one geared towards higher-end systems for the best immersion. The other is for lower end systems.
